site.description: Ultrasonic radar sensor on the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Bridge over the Panchganga River, Kolhapur. Monitors real-time water stage at the primary urban crossing. Sensor Mount Elevation: 549.35m MSL.
Primary Panchganga flood & water-level monitoring barrage (Kasba Bawada). Alert thresholds referenced to WRD Maharashtra MSL datum.
